Close the books faster

Our platform helps finance teams close the books faster by reconciling every bank feed, card statement and invoice automatically, flagging mismatches for review, routing approvals to the right owner, keeping a complete audit trail for every change, and exporting clean journals to the general ledger at the end of each period without spreadsheets or manual copy and paste between tools. Controllers see the status of every account on one screen and can reopen a period when a late adjustment arrives.
